# Fix brief: ENG-412 — Discount row excluded from invoice total

> Generated by Mage from a **reproduced** diagnosis. Repo `acme/shop` at
> `3f9a2c1`.
> Mage run: https://mage.example.com/runs/run_01j0000000e008000000000002 · Linear: https://linear.app/acme/issue/ENG-412/invoice-total-wrong

## Problem
Invoice total ignores discount
> Customer Acme reports the invoice total on /invoices/42 shows $100 instead of $120 after applying the loyalty discount.

## Root cause
`computeTotal` filters line items by `kind === 'item'`, so the discount adjustment row never reaches the sum.

Diagnosis summary (from the diagnosing agent):
> Reproduced on a fresh fork: the total renders $100.00.

## Evidence
| # | Location | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [`src/billing/total.ts:40-52`](https://github.com/acme/shop/blob/3f9a2c1e8b7d6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a39/src/billing/total.ts#L40-L52) | sums line items but skips the discount row |
| 2 | [`src/billing/discount.ts:10-14`](https://github.com/acme/shop/blob/3f9a2c1e8b7d6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a39/src/billing/discount.ts#L10-L14) |  |

Observed failure: `exit_code` exact `1`

## Repro script
`repro.sh` (Shell, method `api`), saved as `.mage/repro/cse_01/repro.sh`
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
curl -sf "$MAGE_BASE_URL/api/invoices/42" | jq -e '.total == 120'
```

## Suggested approach
> Include `kind === 'adjustment'` rows in the reduce, or sum before filtering.

Likely edit sites: [`src/billing/total.ts:44-47`](https://github.com/acme/shop/blob/3f9a2c1e8b7d6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a39/src/billing/total.ts#L44-L47)
